# Mission Trip Planning Software for Churches

> Free mission trip planning and management software for churches and ministries — plan trips, run fundraising, track donors, collect applications and e-signatures, and manage budgets, with no platform fees. Powered by GO by MKDSCPLS.

This site helps church missions teams and trip leaders plan and manage short-term mission trips. The software itself is GO by MKDSCPLS; get started for free at https://go.mkdscpls.com/get-started.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://missiontripplanning.com/): What mission trip planning software does and why it's free.
- [Features](https://missiontripplanning.com/features): Trip management, fundraising, donor tracking, applications, e-signatures.
- [Pricing](https://missiontripplanning.com/pricing): Free to use — no platform fees.
- [Compare](https://missiontripplanning.com/compare): How it compares to other mission trip management tools.

## Guides
- [How to plan a mission trip](https://missiontripplanning.com/how-to-plan-a-mission-trip): Step-by-step planning guide for churches.
- [Mission trip checklist](https://missiontripplanning.com/checklist): What to prepare before a short-term mission trip.
- [Mission trip budget](https://missiontripplanning.com/budget): How to estimate and manage mission trip costs.

## Get started
- [Start free](https://go.mkdscpls.com/get-started): Create your church's mission trip on GO by MKDSCPLS.
